title: Shaanxi Mengchuang Nano New Materials Co., Ltd. | China Aerogel Manufacturer
content:
Shaanxi Mengchuang Nano New Materials Co., Ltd. is a Chinese nano-materials manufacturer founded in 2011 and focused on R&D, design, production, sales, and application engineering for thermal-protection and safety materials. Its official site explicitly lists nano aerogel powder, insulation paper, insulation boards, and nano protective coatings for aerospace, chemical energy, industrial furnace, building, cryogenic, fire-protection, and rail applications.

Company Overview

The company presents itself as a high-tech enterprise with an independent intellectual-property system and active participation in the national standard GB/T 34336-2017 for nanoporous aerogel composite insulation products. Public materials emphasize domestic substitution, patent development, and integrated system solutions for safety protection and energy saving.

Coverage and Focus

  • Coverage Area: Mainland China with engineering-oriented supply into multiple strategic sectors.
  • Focus Areas: Aerospace and defense, energy and chemical processing, industrial furnaces, building insulation, deep-cold systems, fire protection, and rail transit.

Main Products and Capacity

  • Nano aerogel powder
  • Nano insulation paper
  • Multidimensional insulation boards and composite protection boards
  • Structural thermal-protection and fire-resistant nano coating materials
  • Public Capacity: Specific current annual output is not clearly disclosed on the reviewed official pages.

Production Sites and Certifications

  • Main Operating Location: Xi'an, Shaanxi, China.
  • International Certifications: Public pages highlight participation in GB/T 34336-2017, 73 patent applications, 55 granted certificates, and multiple innovation awards; specific international certificate numbers are not clearly listed on the reviewed pages.
  • Official Website: http://www.sxmcnm.com/

FAQ

What does Shaanxi Mengchuang Nano New Materials manufacture?

The company publicly lists nano aerogel powder, insulation paper, insulation boards, and thermal-protection coating materials for demanding industrial and infrastructure applications.

Which industries does the company serve?

Its official site highlights aerospace, energy and chemical, industrial furnace, building insulation, cryogenic systems, fire protection, and rail-transit scenarios.

Does the company publish certification or standards information?

The company states participation in the GB/T 34336-2017 standard and discloses patents, certificates, and innovation awards, but detailed international certification data is not clearly published on the reviewed pages.
